alt: Manage Permissions for a Finance role scrolled to the Billing group: Invoices View, every Payment Cards box and Plan View and Update are ticked
_source: Local EF app (EF_APP=http://127.0.0.1:8010), demo organization 798. The Finance role is a fictional fixture row (fixtures/organization/roles.json: the org's real roles plus Finance with the Finance preset's permissions). The capture reloads the list, opens Finance's menu, Manage Permissions, and scrolls to the Billing and Organization groups. Re-shoot: EF_APP=<local app> node tools/shots/shoot.cjs organization-role-permissions-billing

actions.eval: (() => { const sc = document.querySelector('.ant-modal-content .simplebar-content-wrapper'); const h = [...sc.querySelectorAll('h3.col-label')].find(t => t.textContent.trim() === 'Billing'); sc.scrollTop += h.getBoundingClientRect().top - sc.getBoundingClientRect().top - 56; })()
